title: corone nocturna
intro: Corone nocturna, commonly known as the night-blooming jasmine, is a flowering plant native to tropical regions. The night-blooming jasmine has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation due to its sedative properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to the ability to calm the nervous system and promote a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of the night-blooming jasmine include flavonoids, alkaloids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
